positions.summary: Building production systems where cloud software, connected devices, and applied AI meet.
highlights: Contribute to SmartThings Pro Web Lounge, a cloud-native hospitality-IoT platform for authorized creation, provisioning, and governance of smart-device experiences.
Translate requirements into maintainable backend, frontend, data, and API designs. Build role-aware workflows, QR-based access governance, PMS-facing lifecycle APIs, and paginated data access.
Improve performance and cluster-safe scheduled processing, applying practical judgment to security, scalability, and concurrency.
Built an AI-assisted, prompt-guided video-production proof of concept, recognized as the Application Team’s Best Engineering Product and selected among Samsung R&D Bangladesh’s top products.
Contributed to confidential thermal-management research for mobile video recording, balancing device temperature, compute workload, and perceptible video quality.

positions.summary: Business software with a focus on reliable workflows.
highlights: Contributed to Odoo-based ERP development in Python, including automated invoice-reporting workflows, clean-code practices, Git-based collaboration, and code review.
